name: Spyder Technologies

about:
Spyder Technologies, Inc. operates as a local DISH retailer from its office at 1025 Southwest Boulevard, Suite B, in Jefferson City, Missouri. The company’s founding year, ownership structure, and founders are not disclosed in public materials.

The business sells and installs DISH satellite television packages — including the America’s Top 120, 200, and 250 channel lineups — and provides the Hopper 3 Smart DVR as part of its standard offering. It also resells Starlink residential internet service, with plans starting at $50 per month. Installation is performed by professional technicians, and the company advertises free standard installation on qualifying DISH orders. No facility size, headcount, or volume metrics are published.

Customers are primarily residential households in the Jefferson City area and surrounding Missouri communities. Marketing highlights special pricing for seniors, military personnel, and front‑line workers, indicating a focus on price‑sensitive and service‑oriented consumer segments.

Spyder Technologies emphasizes local presence and service reliability, promoting a two‑year price guarantee, HD free for life, a signal‑reliability money‑back guarantee, and 24/7 customer support as differentiators. The company positions itself as a community‑based alternative to national providers, stressing consistent, reliable local service.
